bullets.text: A sinkhole on Old Mahabalipuram Road in Chennai trapped an SUV near an underground Metro site, causing severe traffic jams.
A biryani shop employee named Haris was killed in a hit-and-run crash near an Indian Oil petrol bunk in Medavakkam.
An illegal boat ride in Pulicat Lake sparked a violent clash between rival fishermen, sending seven people to the hospital in Ponneri.
Minister Rajiv inaugurated the Online Music Permission Management and Monitoring System help desk in Chennai.
Housing and Urban Development Minister Rajkumar celebrated TVK's by-election victories by bursting firecrackers and distributing sweets in Melmaruvathur.
CUMTA proposed a bus-priority corridor linking Tambaram, Velachery, Pallavaram, and Taramani to improve public transport.
Severe financial constraints forced the CMDA to abruptly halt 50 out of 57 infrastructure projects worth Rs 1,340.3 crore.
The Greater Chennai Corporation started repairing pothole-ridden roads across the city for Rs 21.80 crore ahead of the northeast monsoon.
Residents in Thiruvengidapuram are worried as the local Village Administrative Officer office is heavily damaged and on the verge of collapsing.
The 14.6-kilometer Poonamallee-Vadapalani stretch of Chennai Metro Phase II is scheduled for inauguration on October 11.
Ambika Jain has been appointed as the new commissioner of the Avadi Corporation, replacing Saranya.
MeitY urged social media platforms to remove manipulated and out-of-context content alongside AI-generated deepfakes.
Over 4,700 government schools in Tamil Nadu faced internet disruptions after being shifted to BSNL connections.
MeitY will publish a public consultation paper within a month to establish a techno-legal regulatory framework for artificial intelligence.
Auto drivers staged a protest in Periyapalayam condemning the TVK government over local transportation issues.
Opposition leaders criticized the TVK government over deteriorating law and order issues across Tamil Nadu.
Maragatham Kumaravel won the Madurantakam by-election, securing the constituency for TVK.
The MeitY Pavilion showcased India's digital innovations and emerging technology capabilities at the India Mobile Congress 2026 in New Delhi.
